P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The garden is enclosed by a continuous metal fence with a gate, creating defined edges. The house walls and overhang provide side and overhead enclosure, forming a clear outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Ground cover and low shrubs are present, but no trees or tall canopy layer is visible in the garden bed; planting reads as two layers, not lush and layered.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The composition is horizontally balanced with multiple competing elements: the gable, the central entry, and the right-side windows all draw equal attention. No single dominant focal point organizes the space.
